lea.text: Ravidel is the foe at the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor, where Liana gives the Moxen to Kristina and Jared during her duel with him so he will not take them.
Ravidel nonetheless uses Mox Jet, Mox Ruby and Mox Sapphire to activate the Mox Beacon against Jared and his allies.

leg.text: In Legends, Ravidel conquers Arathoxia, while Jared steals the Lotus and leads refugees against him at Castle Melmereth, summoning a Shivan Dragon.
Ravidel creates the Mox Beacon to lure Corondor's old enemies, forcing six planeswalkers to battle in the Planeswalker War.
At the Dueling Chasm Jared battles him and ascends as a planeswalker, while Ravidel unsummons Caliphear to an unknown location.
Ravidel is killed but revived by Kristina and Taysir, and he plots vengeance, fashioning Chromium's corpse into the Planar Barge.

hml.text: In Homelands, Adam Carthalion's army is destroyed at the Battle of Aster Fall and Ravidel takes up residence in Castle Melmereth.
Ravidel defeats Adam at Ephren, and Adam entrusts his spelltrove and infant Jared to Ezer before obliterating Ravidel's barge and himself with Inferno.
Ravidel attacks Arathoxia with juggernauts and a Chaos Orb, and Jared swears vengeance on Ravidel for the murder of his parents.
In Castle Melmereth Ravidel reveals that Adam was a liar and killer who murdered Gwendolyn for power, before Jared crushes the Black Lotus to summon a Shivan Dragon that destroys the castle.
